nodes.name: Get Unread Mail
nodes.notes: Gmail OAuth2 credential (read-only scope) is attached by the user in the n8n editor and lives ONLY in n8n's credential store (ADR-0004) — it is never part of this export. simple: true fetches metadata only (format=metadata with From/To/Cc/Bcc/Subject headers), never the message body — the dossier's privacy rule by construction. filters map to the Gmail query 'is:unread after:<epoch-24h>'; limit: 25 becomes maxResults=25 (first page only), so no more than the 25 most recent unread messages are ever pulled. alwaysOutputData keeps the workflow running on a zero-message window (one empty item) so the formatter can answer pleasantly.

nodes.name: Summarize with Ollama
nodes.notes: Local prioritization/summarization (dossier privacy rule: email data never leaves the machine — Ollama is local). host.docker.internal:11434 is the settled address for Ollama from inside n8n — it requires the host's Ollama to listen on a container-reachable interface (OLLAMA_HOST), not only 127.0.0.1 (user-gated fix, FEAT-002 dossier). onError: continueRegularOutput means a down/slow Ollama flows an error item to Finalize Reply, which falls back to the deterministic slice-1 list instead of failing the webhook. The 75s node timeout sits inside the gateway's 90s email_review dispatch budget (FEAT-004), leaving room for the Gmail fetch and overhead.
